<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
<title>Aero</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64," />
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0d6bd0" />
<style>
  @font-face { font-family: "Aero"; src: url(data:font/otf;base64,) format("opentype"); font-weight: 100 900; font-style: normal; font-display: swap; }
  html { font-synthesis: none; }
  button, input, select, textarea { font-family: inherit; }
  :root {
    --bg: #000;
    --panelA: .72;
    --panel: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,calc(var(--panelA) * .46)) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,calc(var(--panelA) * .14)) 49%, rgba(90,190,255,calc(var(--panelA) * .20)) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,calc(var(--panelA) * .12)) 100%), rgba(10,45,90,calc(var(--panelA) * .45));
    --panel-2: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.34), rgba(120,210,255,.2));
    --acc: #3fc1ff; --r: 16px; --blur: 14px; --fs: 16px; --cardmin: 150px; --tile: 64px;
    --t: 1; --mv: 14px; --lift: -3px; --press: .95; --ease: cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.3,1);
    --line: rgba(255,255,255,.42);
    --text: #ffffff;
    --dim: #d4ecff;
    --accent: #ffffff;
    --glow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { background: #000; }
  html { font-size: var(--fs); }
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; color: var(--text);
    font-family: "Aero", "Segoe UI", "Frutiger", "Frutiger Linotype", "Myriad Pro", "Trebuchet MS", "Lucida Grande", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,30,70,.55); }
  body { overflow-x: hidden; }
  #bgvideo { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; z-index: 0; background: #000; }
  .bgalt { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; display: none; background-size: cover; background-position: center; }
  .bgshade { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; background: #000; opacity: .25; }
  #fx { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 100; overflow: hidden; }
  .rip { position: fixed; width: 12px; height: 12px; margin: -6px 0 0 -6px; border: 2px solid var(--acc); border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--acc); animation: rip .62s ease-out forwards; }
  @keyframes rip { to { transform: scale(6.5); opacity: 0; } }
  .petal { position: fixed; width: 9px; height: 13px; margin: -6px 0 0 -4px; border-radius: 85% 0 85% 0;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--acc) 40%, #fff), var(--acc)); animation: petal .85s cubic-bezier(.15,.7,.3,1) forwards; }
  @keyframes petal { to { transform: translate(var(--dx), var(--dy)) rotate(var(--rot)) scale(.5); opacity: 0; } }
  .card, .nav button, .pbtn, .btn, .chip, .bgtile, .exit { transition: transform .12s, border-color .15s, background .15s, color .15s; }
  .card:active { transform: scale(.95); }
  .nav button:active, .pbtn:active, .btn:active, .chip:active, .exit:active, .bgtile:active { transform: scale(.94); }
  .opt { margin-bottom: 26px; max-width: 760px; }
  .opt h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 1.05rem; }
  .bgtiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(118px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin: 12px 0; }
  .bgtile { all: unset; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 12px; height: 74px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; border: 2px solid var(--line);
    display: flex; align-items: flex-end; box-sizing: border-box; background-size: cover; background-position: center; }
  .bgtile span { width: 100%; padding: 5px 8px; font-size: .74rem; font-weight: 600; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,.78)); }
  .bgtile:hover { border-color: #777; }
  .bgtile.on { border-color: var(--acc); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--acc) 35%, transparent); }
  input[type=range] { width: 100%; accent-color: var(--acc); }
  .chk { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--text); font-size: .92rem; cursor: pointer; }
  .chk input { width: 18px; height: 18px; accent-color: var(--acc); }
  .msg { font-size: .82rem; color: var(--dim); min-height: 1.2em; margin-top: 6px; }

  .side, .card, .stat, .search, .hint, .chip, .pside, .phandle, .menu button {
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur)); backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur)); }
  .side { position: fixed; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 220px; background: var(--panel);
    border-right: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 18px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; z-index: 5; }
  .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 4px 8px 18px; }
  .brand img { width: 44px; height: 44px; object-fit: contain; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(255,150,200,.45)); }
  .brand b { font-size: 1.35rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; }
  .nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
  .nav button, .exit { all: unset; cursor: pointer; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--dim);
    font-size: 0.95rem; transition: background .15s, color .15s; }
  .nav button:hover, .exit:hover { background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--text); }
  .nav button.on { background: var(--panel-2); color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--acc); }
  .spacer { flex: 1; }
  .exit { border: 1px solid var(--line); text-align: center; }
  main { margin-left: 220px; padding: 28px 32px 60px; position: relative; z-index: 1; min-height: 100%; }
  h1 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 1.6rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
  .sub { color: var(--dim); margin: 0 0 22px; font-size: 0.95rem; }
  .hero { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; padding: 40px 0 28px; }
  .hero img { width: 190px; height: 190px; object-fit: contain; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 28px rgba(255,150,200,.40)); }
  .hero h1 { font-size: 3rem; letter-spacing: 0.22em; margin-top: 18px; text-shadow: 0 2px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.6); }
  .search { width: 100%; max-width: 520px; margin: 0 auto 26px; display: block; padding: 13px 18px; border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text); font-size: 1rem; outline: none; }
  .search:focus { border-color: #444; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--glow); }
  .bar { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .bar .search { margin: 0; max-width: 360px; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; }
  .chip { all: unset; cursor: pointer; background: var(--panel); padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line);
    color: var(--dim); font-size: 0.85rem; }
  .chip.on, .chip:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: #555; }
  .chip.on { border-color: var(--acc); color: #fff; }
  .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
  .card { position: relative; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px;
    cursor: pointer; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; min-height: 112px; transition: transform .12s, border-color .12s; }
  .card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: #4a4a55; }
  .tile { position: relative; overflow: hidden; width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 14px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.15rem;
    color: #fff; background: hsl(var(--h) 35% 22%); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--h) 35% 32%); }
  .tile img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; background: #111; }
  .name { font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 600; word-break: break-word; }
  .fav { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 10px; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #555; background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; padding: 2px; }
  .fav.on { color: #ffd45e; }
  .fav:hover { color: #ffd45e; }
  .more { display: block; margin: 22px auto 0; }
  .empty { color: var(--dim); padding: 40px 0; text-align: center; }
  .stats { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 30px; }
  .stat { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px 26px; text-align: center; }
  .stat b { display: block; font-size: 1.6rem; }
  .stat span { color: var(--dim); font-size: 0.8rem; }
  .row { display: grid; gap: 14px; max-width: 560px; margin-bottom: 26px; }
  label { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--dim); display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  input.f, select.f { width: 100%; padding: 11px 14px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text);
    border-radius: 10px; font-size: 0.95rem; outline: none; }
  input.f:focus, select.f:focus { border-color: #555; }
  .btn { all: unset; cursor: pointer; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--text); color: #000; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; }
  .btn.ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .btns { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .player { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 20; background: #000; display: none; }
  .player.open { display: flex; }
  .pstage { flex: 1; min-width: 0; position: relative; background: #000; }
  .pstage iframe { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; background: #fff; display: block; }
  .pside { width: 250px; flex: none; background: var(--panel); border-left: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 18px 16px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; transition: margin-right .2s; }
  .player.collapsed .pside { margin-right: -250px; }
  .pgame { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 0 14px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .pgame .tile { width: 92px; height: 92px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 2rem; }
  .plabel { font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--dim); }
  .ptitle { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; word-break: break-word; }
  .pplays { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--dim); }
  .pbtn { all: unset; cursor: pointer; display: block; text-align: center; padding: 11px 14px; border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.92rem; background: var(--panel-2); }
  .pbtn:hover { border-color: #55555f; }
  .pbtn.fav-on { color: #ffd45e; border-color: #6b5a22; }
  .pbtn.primary { background: var(--text); color: #000; border-color: var(--text); }
  .pbtn.danger:hover { border-color: #a55; }
  .pnote { font-size: 0.74rem; color: var(--dim); line-height: 1.4; margin-top: auto; }
  .phandle { all: unset; cursor: pointer; position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 0; transform: translateY(-50%); z-index: 3;
    background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-right: 0; border-radius: 10px 0 0 10px; padding: 14px 7px; color: var(--dim); }
  .phandle:hover { color: var(--text); }
  .section { margin-bottom: 30px; }
  .section h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 1.1rem; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
  .section .sub { margin-bottom: 12px; }
  main h1, main h2, .sub, .stat span, .name, .empty { text-shadow: 0 1px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.85); }
  .hero .sub { color: #fff; font-weight: 600; text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,.95), 0 2px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.95); }
  .hint { background: var(--panel); color: var(--text); font-size: 0.88rem; padding: 14px 16px; border: 1px dashed var(--line); border-radius: 12px; }
  .badge { position: absolute; bottom: 10px; right: 10px; font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--dim); }
  .menu { display: none; position: fixed; top: 12px; left: 12px; z-index: 6; }
  .menu button { all: unset; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px 14px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; }
  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    .side { transform: translateX(-100%); transition: transform .2s; }
    .side.open { transform: none; }
    main { margin-left: 0; padding: 60px 16px 50px; }
    .menu { display: block; }
    .hero h1 { font-size: 2.2rem; }
    .pside { width: 210px; }
    .player.collapsed .pside { margin-right: -210px; }
  }
  /* ===== appearance overrides ===== */
  .grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(var(--cardmin), 1fr)); }
  .grid .tile { width: var(--tile); height: var(--tile); font-size: calc(var(--tile) * .3); }
  .card, .stat, .hint { border-radius: var(--r); }
  .tile { border-radius: calc(var(--r) * .9); }
  .pgame .tile { border-radius: calc(var(--r) * 1.4); }
  .btn, .pbtn, input.f, select.f, .nav button, .exit, .bgtile { border-radius: calc(var(--r) * .72); }
  .search:focus { border-color: var(--acc); }

  /* ===== animation levels ===== */
  html.anim-subtle { --mv: 0px; --lift: -1px; --press: .98; --ease: ease-out; }
  html.anim-playful { --mv: 28px; --lift: -7px; --press: .9; --ease: cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); }
  html.anim-off *, html.anim-off *::before, html.anim-off *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }

  /* smooth hover / press on everything interactive */
  .card, .stat, .nav button, .pbtn, .btn, .chip, .bgtile, .exit, .fav, .search, input.f, select.f, .phandle {
    transition: transform calc(.22s * var(--t)) var(--ease), border-color calc(.2s * var(--t)), background calc(.2s * var(--t)),
      color calc(.2s * var(--t)), box-shadow calc(.25s * var(--t)), opacity calc(.2s * var(--t)); }
  .card:hover { transform: translateY(var(--lift)); border-color: var(--acc); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--acc) 40%, transparent); }
  html.anim-playful .card:hover { transform: translateY(var(--lift)) rotate(-1.2deg) scale(1.03); }
  .card:active { transform: scale(var(--press)); }
  .stat:hover { transform: translateY(var(--lift)); }
  .nav button:hover { transform: translateX(4px); }
  .nav button:active, .pbtn:active, .btn:active, .chip:active, .exit:active, .bgtile:active { transform: scale(var(--press)); }
  .btn:hover, .pbtn:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--acc), 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.4); }
  .fav:hover { transform: scale(1.25); }
  .brand img { transition: transform calc(.5s * var(--t)) var(--ease); }
  .brand:hover img { transform: rotate(-14deg) scale(1.1); }

  /* page + card entrance (only for a moment after switching page) */
  @keyframes pgIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(var(--mv)); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  @keyframes cardIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(var(--mv)) scale(.92); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  main.pg > * { animation: pgIn calc(.55s * var(--t)) var(--ease) backwards; animation-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 55ms * var(--t)); }
  main.pg .card { animation: cardIn calc(.5s * var(--t)) var(--ease) backwards; animation-delay: calc(120ms * var(--t) + var(--i, 0) * 30ms * var(--t)); }
  main.pg .stat { animation: cardIn calc(.55s * var(--t)) var(--ease) backwards; animation-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 90ms * var(--t) + 200ms * var(--t)); }

  /* gentle floating logo */
  @keyframes floaty { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-9px); } }
  html.anim-smooth .hero img, html.anim-playful .hero img { animation: floaty calc(6s * var(--t)) ease-in-out infinite; }

  /* favorite star pop */
  @keyframes favPop { 0% { transform: scale(1); } 40% { transform: scale(1.9) rotate(18deg); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }
  .fav.pop, .pbtn.pop { animation: favPop calc(.5s * var(--t)) var(--ease); }

  /* game player open / close */
  @keyframes plIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
  @keyframes plOut { to { opacity: 0; } }
  @keyframes stageIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.965); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  @keyframes stageOut { to { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.97); } }
  @keyframes sideIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(60px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  @keyframes sideOut { to { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(60px); } }
  .player.open { animation: plIn calc(.3s * var(--t)) ease both; }
  .player.open .pstage { animation: stageIn calc(.5s * var(--t)) var(--ease) both; }
  .player.open .pside { animation: sideIn calc(.55s * var(--t)) var(--ease) both; }
  .player.open .pside > * { animation: pgIn calc(.45s * var(--t)) var(--ease) backwards; }
  .player.open .pside > :nth-child(1) { animation-delay: calc(.15s * var(--t)); }
  .player.open .pside > :nth-child(2) { animation-delay: calc(.22s * var(--t)); }
  .player.open .pside > :nth-child(3) { animation-delay: calc(.29s * var(--t)); }
  .player.open .pside > :nth-child(4) { animation-delay: calc(.36s * var(--t)); }
  .player.open .pside > :nth-child(5) { animation-delay: calc(.43s * var(--t)); }
  .player.open .pside > .pop { animation: favPop calc(.5s * var(--t)) var(--ease); animation-delay: 0s !important; }
  .player.open.closing { animation: plOut calc(.25s * var(--t)) ease both; }
  .player.open.closing .pstage { animation: stageOut calc(.25s * var(--t)) ease both; }
  .player.open.closing .pside { animation: sideOut calc(.25s * var(--t)) ease both; }
  .player.open.closing .pside > * { animation: none; }
  .player .pside { transition: margin-right calc(.35s * var(--t)) var(--ease); }

  /* background cross-fade */
  @keyframes bgIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
  .bgin { animation: bgIn calc(.8s * var(--t)) ease both; }

  /* toast */
  #toast { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 28px; z-index: 120; padding: 11px 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--acc); color: #fff; font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 600; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(-50%, 24px) scale(.95); transition: opacity calc(.3s * var(--t)), transform calc(.4s * var(--t)) var(--ease);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur)); backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur)); }
  #toast.show { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0) scale(1); }

  /* settings widgets */
  .swatches { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; margin: 8px 0 4px; }
  .sw { all: unset; cursor: pointer; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25); box-sizing: border-box;
    transition: transform calc(.2s * var(--t)) var(--ease), border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; }
  .sw:hover { transform: scale(1.18); }
  .sw.on { border-color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 45%, transparent); }
  input[type=color] { width: 36px; height: 30px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 8px; }
  .chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 8px 0 14px; }
  .lookgrid { display: grid; gap: 14px; max-width: 560px; margin-top: 6px; }
  .lookgrid label b { color: var(--text); font-weight: 600; }
  /* ===== Frutiger Aero ===== */
  :root { --gloss: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.62) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.18) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 51%); }
  .bgshade { opacity: .12; }
  #bubbles { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; }
  .bub { position: absolute; bottom: -80px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, rgba(255,255,255,.95) 0, rgba(255,255,255,.5) 12%, rgba(150,225,255,.22) 48%, rgba(255,255,255,.1) 72%, rgba(255,255,255,.35) 100%);
    box-shadow: inset 0 -6px 12px rgba(120,210,255,.35), 0 0 14px rgba(160,225,255,.35); opacity: 0;
    animation: bubUp var(--d, 22s) linear var(--dl, 0s) infinite; }
  @keyframes bubUp { 0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(.6); opacity: 0; } 8% { opacity: .85; } 50% { transform: translate(var(--sx, 30px), -60vh) scale(1); }
    92% { opacity: .7; } 100% { transform: translate(calc(var(--sx, 30px) * -1), -118vh) scale(1.08); opacity: 0; } }
  html.anim-off #bubbles { display: none; }
  body.nobub #bubbles { display: none; }

  .side { background: var(--panel); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);
    box-shadow: inset -1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35), 6px 0 28px rgba(0,40,90,.35); }
  .side::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto 0; height: 130px; pointer-events: none; background: var(--gloss); opacity: .5; }
  .brand b { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #bfeaff 55%, #6fd0ff 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent;
    text-shadow: none; filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,50,110,.6)); letter-spacing: .06em; }
  .brand img { filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 6px rgba(0,60,120,.55)); }
  .nav button, .exit { color: #eaf7ff; border: 1px solid transparent; }
  .nav button:hover, .exit:hover { background: var(--panel-2); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.55); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7); color: #fff; }
  .nav button.on { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #8fdcff 0%, #35aef0 48%, #1a8ad8 52%, #52c8ff 100%); border-color: #0f78c2; color: #fff;
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.75), 0 2px 8px rgba(0,70,140,.55); text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0,60,120,.7); }

  .card, .stat, .hint, .pside { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.75), inset 0 -10px 18px rgba(80,180,255,.12), 0 6px 18px rgba(0,40,90,.3); }
  .card::after, .stat::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto 0; height: 46%; border-radius: inherit; border-bottom-left-radius: 60% 22%; border-bottom-right-radius: 60% 22%;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.34), rgba(255,255,255,0)); pointer-events: none; }
  .stat { position: relative; }
  .card:hover { border-color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #fff, 0 10px 26px rgba(0,40,90,.4), 0 0 22px color-mix(in srgb, var(--acc) 60%, transparent); }
  .tile { box-shadow: inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255,255,255,.7), inset 0 -6px 10px rgba(0,60,120,.28), 0 3px 8px rgba(0,40,90,.4); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, hsl(var(--h) 70% 62%), hsl(var(--h) 75% 38%)); }
  .tile::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 0 45% 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.55), rgba(255,255,255,.05)); border-radius: inherit; pointer-events: none; }
  .tile img { background: rgba(255,255,255,.2); }
  .name { text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,30,70,.7); }
  .fav { color: rgba(255,255,255,.65); text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,40,90,.7); z-index: 2; }
  .fav.on, .fav:hover { color: #ffe27a; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,220,100,.9), 0 1px 2px rgba(120,70,0,.6); }

  .search, input.f, select.f { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,50,100,.35), rgba(255,255,255,.18)); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.65);
    box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(0,40,90,.45), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4); color: #fff; }
  .search::placeholder, input.f::placeholder { color: rgba(225,243,255,.7); }
  .search:focus, input.f:focus, select.f:focus { border-color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(0,40,90,.45), 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--acc) 55%, transparent), 0 0 18px var(--acc); }
  select.f option { color: #08304f; }

  .btn, .pbtn.primary { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #a3e4ff 0%, #3db6f5 48%, #1788dc 52%, #55cbff 100%); color: #fff; border: 1px solid #0e72ba;
    border-radius: 999px; text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0,60,120,.75); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.85), 0 3px 8px rgba(0,60,130,.5); }
  .btn:hover, .pbtn.primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1) saturate(1.1); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #fff, 0 4px 14px rgba(0,80,160,.6), 0 0 16px var(--acc); }
  .btn.ghost, .pbtn { background: var(--panel); color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.65); border-radius: 999px; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,30,70,.6);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,40,90,.35); }
  .pbtn { border-radius: 999px; }
  .pbtn.fav-on { color: #ffe27a; border-color: #ffe27a; }
  .pbtn.danger:hover { border-color: #ff8f8f; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7), 0 0 14px rgba(255,120,120,.7); }
  .chip { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55); color: #eaf7ff; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6); }
  .chip:hover { border-color: #fff; }
  .chip.on { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #8fdcff 0%, #35aef0 48%, #1a8ad8 52%, #52c8ff 100%); border-color: #0f78c2; color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.75); }

  .hero img { filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 14px rgba(0,50,110,.6)) drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(140,220,255,.55)); }
  .hero h1 { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #c8efff 50%, #6fd0ff 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent;
    text-shadow: none; filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgba(0,50,110,.65)); letter-spacing: .14em; }
  .hero .sub { text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,30,70,.85); }
  h1, h2 { text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,30,70,.75); }
  .section h2, .opt h2 { padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35); display: inline-block; min-width: 40%; }

  .player { background: #04101f; }
  .pside { background: var(--panel); border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6); border-radius: 0; -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur)); backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur)); }
  .phandle { background: var(--panel); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.6); color: #fff; }
  .pgame { border-bottom-color: rgba(255,255,255,.35); }

  #toast { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.55), rgba(90,190,255,.45) 50%, rgba(20,120,210,.7) 52%, rgba(90,200,255,.55));
    border: 1px solid #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0,60,120,.8); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8), 0 6px 22px rgba(0,60,130,.55); }
  .bgtile { border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6); box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0,40,90,.4); }
  .bgtile span { text-shadow: 0 1px 2px #000; }
  .sw { border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8); box-shadow: inset 0 3px 4px rgba(255,255,255,.7), inset 0 -4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25), 0 2px 5px rgba(0,40,90,.45); }
  input[type=range] { height: 6px; }
  .rip { border-color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--acc), inset 0 0 10px var(--acc); }
  .petal { border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85); width: 12px; height: 12px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, #fff 0, rgba(255,255,255,.6) 14%, rgba(130,215,255,.35) 55%, rgba(255,255,255,.2) 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(150,225,255,.7); }
  ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 12px; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: rgba(0,40,90,.25); }
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #bfeaff, #4db8f5 55%, #1a8ad8); border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8); }
  .msg, .sub, label { text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,30,70,.75); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<video id="bgvideo" poster="data:image/jpeg;base64," autoplay muted loop playsinline preload="auto"></video>
<div class="bgalt" id="bgalt"></div>
<div class="bgshade" id="bgshade"></div>
<div id="bubbles" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<div id="fx"></div>
<div id="toast" role="status"></div>
<div class="menu"><button id="menuBtn" aria-label="Menu">☰ Aero</button></div>

<aside class="side" id="side">
  <div class="brand"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Aero" /><b>Aero</b></div>
  <nav class="nav" id="nav">
    <button data-p="home" class="on">Home</button>
    <button data-p="games">Games</button>
    <button data-p="apps">Apps</button>
    <button data-p="favs">Favorites</button>
    <button data-p="settings">Settings</button>
  </nav>
  <div class="spacer"></div>
  <button class="exit" id="quick">Quick exit ↗</button>
</aside>

<main id="main"></main>

<div class="player" id="player">
  <div class="pstage" id="pstage">
    <iframe id="pframe" allow="autoplay; fullscreen; gamepad; clipboard-write" referrerpolicy="no-referrer"></iframe>
    <button class="phandle" id="phandle" title="Show / hide panel">‹</button>
  </div>
  <aside class="pside" id="pside">
    <div class="pgame">
      <div class="tile" id="pico"></div>
      <div><div class="plabel">Now playing</div><div class="ptitle" id="ptitle"></div><div class="pplays" id="pplays"></div></div>
    </div>
    <button class="pbtn" id="pfav">☆ Add to favorites</button>
    <button class="pbtn primary" id="pfull">⛶ Fullscreen</button>
    <button class="pbtn" id="pnew">Open in new tab</button>
    <button class="pbtn danger" id="pclose">✕ Close game</button>
    <div class="pnote">Blank screen? Some sites refuse to load inside a frame. Use “Open in new tab”.</div>
  </aside>
</div>

function cardHTML(item, idx, src) {
  var t = item[0], u = item[1], ic = item[2] || "", ch = (t.match(/[A-Za-z0-9]/) || ["?"])[0].toUpperCase();
  var tile = '<div class="tile" style="--h:' + hue(t) + '">' + esc(ch) +
    (ic ? '<img src="' + esc(ic) + '" alt="" loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" onerror="this.remove()" />' : '') + '</div>';
  return '<div class="card" data-u="' + esc(u) + '">' +
    '<button class="fav ' + (isFav(u) ? "on" : "") + '" data-fav="' + esc(u) + '" title="Favorite">★</button>' +
    tile + '<div class="name">' + esc(t) + '</div></div>';
}

function listFor(src) {
  if (src === "apps") return APPS;

function renderHome() {
  main.innerHTML =

  var picks = [], used = {};
  while (picks.length < 12 && picks.length < GAMES.length) { var i = Math.floor(Math.random() * GAMES.length); if (!used[i]) { used[i] = 1; picks.push(i); } }
  document.getElementById("grid").innerHTML = picks.map(function (i) { return cardHTML(GAMES[i], i, "games"); }).join("");
  document.getElementById("homeSearch").addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Enter") { query = this.value; letter = ""; shown = 120; go("games"); }

}

function renderList() {

    return true;

  var letters = ["#"].concat("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".split(""));
  var sections = "";
  if (src === "games" && !q && !letter) {
    var fv = favs.map(function (u) { return BYURL[u]; }).filter(Boolean);
    var top = GAMES.filter(function (x) { return playsOf(x[1]) > 0; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return playsOf(b[1]) - playsOf(a[1]) || a[0].localeCompare(b[0]); }).slice(0, 12);
    sections =

      (fv.length ? '<div class="grid">' + fv.slice(0, 12).map(function (x) { return cardHTML(x); }).join("") + '</div>'

      (top.length ? '<div class="grid">' + top.map(function (x) { return cardHTML(x).replace('</div></div>', '</div><span class="badge">' + playsOf(x[1]) + '×</span></div>'); }).join("") + '</div>'

      '<div class="section" style="margin-bottom:8px"><h2>All games</h2></div>';
  }
  main.innerHTML = '<h1 style="margin-bottom:18px">' + title + '</h1>' + sections +

    (src === "games" ? '<button class="chip' + (!letter ? " on" : "") + '" data-l="">All</button>' + letters.map(function (l) { return '<button class="chip' + (letter === l ? " on" : "") + '" data-l="' + l + '">' + l + '</button>'; }).join("") : "") +
    '</div><div class="grid" id="grid"></div><div id="moreWrap"></div>';

  if (!items.length) { grid.outerHTML = '<div class="empty">' + (src === "favs" ? "No favorites yet. Tap ★ on any card." : "Nothing found.") + '</div>'; return; }
  var slice = items.slice(0, shown);

  if (items.length > shown) {
    document.getElementById("moreWrap").innerHTML = '<button class="btn ghost more" id="more">Show more (' + (items.length - shown) + ')</button>';
    document.getElementById("more").onclick = function () { shown += 240; renderList(); };
  }

    query = this.value; shown = 120; var pos = this.selectionStart; renderList();
    var n = document.getElementById("q"); n.focus(); n.setSelectionRange(pos, pos);

    var t0 = performance.now(), d = 900 * T() + 200; el.textContent = "0";
    (function step(now) { var k = Math.min(1, (now - t0 - 200) / d); if (k < 0) k = 0; el.textContent = Math.round(n * (1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3))); if (k < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step); })(t0);
  });
}
function go(p) { page = p; document.getElementById("side").classList.remove("open"); if (p !== "games" && p !== "apps" && p !== "favs") { query = ""; letter = ""; } shown = 120; render(); window.scrollTo(0, 0); pageEnter(); }

function applyCloak() {
  var c = LS.get("cloak", "");
  var link = document.querySelector('link[rel=icon]');
  if (!c) { document.title = ORIG_TITLE; link.href = ICON; return; }
  var parts = c.split("|");
  document.title = parts[0];
  link.href = parts[1] || ICON;
}

function launchBlank() {
  var w = window.open("about:blank", "_blank");
  if (!w) { alert("Pop-up blocked. Allow pop-ups for this page and try again."); return; }
  var doc = w.document;
  doc.title = LS.get("cloak", "").split("|")[0] || "Google";
  doc.body.style.cssText = "margin:0;height:100vh;overflow:hidden";
  var f = doc.createElement("iframe");
  f.style.cssText = "border:0;width:100%;height:100%";
  f.src = location.href;
  doc.body.appendChild(f);
}

function quickExit() { window.location.replace(LS.get("dest", "https://classroom.google.com")); }

var current = null;
function refreshPlayerPanel() {
  if (!current) return;
  var u = current[1], f = isFav(u);
  var b = document.getElementById("pfav");
  b.textContent = f ? "★ Favorited" : "☆ Add to favorites";
  b.classList.toggle("fav-on", f);
  var n = playsOf(u);
  document.getElementById("pplays").textContent = "Played " + n + (n === 1 ? " time" : " times");
}
function openItem(it) {
  if (/^https?:/i.test(it[1]) && APPS.indexOf(it) !== -1) { window.open(it[1], "_blank", "noopener"); return; }
  current = it;
  bgPause();
  plays[it[1]] = playsOf(it[1]) + 1; LS.set("plays", plays);
  document.getElementById("ptitle").textContent = it[0];
  var ch = (it[0].match(/[A-Za-z0-9]/) || ["?"])[0].toUpperCase();
  var pico = document.getElementById("pico");
  pico.style.setProperty("--h", hue(it[0]));
  pico.innerHTML = esc(ch) + (it[2] ? '<img src="' + esc(it[2]) + '" alt="" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" onerror="this.remove()" />' : "");
  refreshPlayerPanel();
  var pl = document.getElementById("player");
  pl.classList.toggle("collapsed", window.innerWidth < 760);
  document.getElementById("pframe").src = it[1];
  pl.classList.add("open");
}
function closePlayer() {
  var pl = document.getElementById("player");
  if (!pl.classList.contains("open") || pl.classList.contains("closing")) return;
  if (animOff()) return closePlayerNow();
  pl.classList.add("closing");
  setTimeout(closePlayerNow, 260 * T());
}
function closePlayerNow() {
  document.getElementById("player").classList.remove("closing");
  if (document.fullscreenElement && document.exitFullscreen) document.exitFullscreen();
  document.getElementById("pframe").src = "about:blank";
  document.getElementById("player").classList.remove("open");
  current = null;
  bgResume();
  if (page === "games" || page === "favs" || page === "home") { var y = window.scrollY; render(); window.scrollTo(0, y); }
}
function rerenderKeepScroll() { var y = window.scrollY; render(); window.scrollTo(0, y); }

main.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
  var f = e.target.closest(".fav");
  if (f) {
    e.stopPropagation(); toggleFav(f.dataset.fav);
    if (page === "games" || page === "favs") rerenderKeepScroll(); else f.classList.toggle("on", isFav(f.dataset.fav)); popFavNow();
    return;
  }
  var chip = e.target.closest(".chip");
  if (chip && chip.dataset.l !== undefined) { letter = chip.dataset.l; shown = 120; renderList(); return; }
  var card = e.target.closest(".card");
  if (card) { var it = BYURL[card.dataset.u]; if (it) openItem(it); }
});

document.getElementById("nav").addEventListener("click", function (e) { var b = e.target.closest("button"); if (b) go(b.dataset.p); });
document.getElementById("menuBtn").onclick = function () { document.getElementById("side").classList.toggle("open"); };
document.getElementById("quick").onclick = quickExit;
document.getElementById("pclose").onclick = closePlayer;
document.getElementById("pnew").onclick = function () { if (current) window.open(current[1], "_blank", "noopener"); };
document.getElementById("pfav").onclick = function () { if (!current) return; toggleFav(current[1]); refreshPlayerPanel(); popFavNow(); };
document.getElementById("phandle").onclick = function () {
  var pl = document.getElementById("player"); pl.classList.toggle("collapsed");
  this.textContent = pl.classList.contains("collapsed") ? "‹" : "›";
};
document.getElementById("pfull").onclick = function () {
  var f = document.getElementById("pframe");
  var fn = f.requestFullscreen || f.webkitRequestFullscreen;
  if (fn) fn.call(f); else window.open(current && current[1], "_blank", "noopener");
  try { f.focus(); } catch (e) {}
};

document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
  var k = LS.get("panic", "");
  if (k && e.key === k) {
    var t = e.target;
    if (e.key.length === 1 && t && (t.tagName === "INPUT" || t.tagName === "TEXTAREA")) return;
    e.preventDefault(); quickExit();
  } else if (e.key === "Escape") closePlayer();
});



/* ---------- appearance ---------- */

  var rng = function (id, label, min, max, step, val, unit) { return '<div><label>' + label + ': <b id="' + id + 'v">' + val + unit + '</b></label><input type="range" id="' + id + '" min="' + min + '" max="' + max + '" step="' + step + '" value="' + val + '" /></div>'; };

function bindLookSettings() {
  var pick = function (id, key, after) {

      [].forEach.call(this.children, function (c) { c.classList.toggle("on", c === b); });
      look[key] = b.dataset.v; saveLook(); applyLook(); if (after) after();
    });
  };

  pick("lk-size", "size");
  var setAcc = function (c) {

    [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll("#lk-acc .sw"), function (s) { s.classList.toggle("on", s.dataset.c === c.toLowerCase()); });
    document.getElementById("lk-custom").value = c;
  };

  document.getElementById("lk-custom").oninput = function () { setAcc(this.value); };
  [["lk-speed", "speed", "×", true], ["lk-radius", "radius", "px"], ["lk-blur", "blur", "px"], ["lk-panel", "panel", "%"], ["lk-fs", "fs", "px"]].forEach(function (r) {

/* ---------- background ---------- */
var BGPRESETS = [
  ["aerosky", "Aero sky", "radial-gradient(60% 16% at 22% 28%, rgba(255,255,255,.9), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(50% 13% at 74% 18%, rgba(255,255,255,.85), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(70% 30% at 52% 108%, #52c53c 0 60%, transparent 61%), radial-gradient(90% 38% at 18% 113%, #36a82a 0 60%, transparent 61%), linear-gradient(180deg,#0d6bd0 0%,#4eb1f3 42%,#b5e6ff 76%,#e8f8ff 100%)"],

  ["midnight", "Midnight", "linear-gradient(160deg,#05050a,#17123a)"],
  ["black", "Pure black", "#000"],
  ["dusk", "Sakura dusk", "linear-gradient(160deg,#2a0f2e,#6b2a5a 55%,#e58fb0)"],
  ["ocean", "Ocean", "linear-gradient(160deg,#021a2b,#0b4a6e 60%,#1fa5b8)"],
  ["forest", "Forest", "linear-gradient(160deg,#04150c,#0f4a2c 60%,#5aa36b)"],
  ["sunset", "Sunset", "linear-gradient(160deg,#1b0a2a,#8a2d5b 50%,#ff9a5a)"],
  ["aurora", "Aurora", "radial-gradient(at 20% 20%,#1d6b5c,transparent 55%),radial-gradient(at 80% 30%,#5b2a8a,transparent 55%),#050912"]
];
var bgState = LS.get("bg", { type: "video" });
var bgAlt = document.getElementById("bgalt");
var bgShade = document.getElementById("bgshade");
var bgObjUrl = null;
function setDim(n) { bgShade.style.opacity = Math.max(0, Math.min(90, n)) / 100; }
setDim(LS.get("dim", 25));

function idb(cb) {
  try {
    var rq = indexedDB.open("sakura", 1);
    rq.onupgradeneeded = function () { rq.result.createObjectStore("kv"); };
    rq.onsuccess = function () { cb(rq.result); };
    rq.onerror = function () { cb(null); };
  } catch (e) { cb(null); }
}
function idbSet(k, v, done) {
  idb(function (db) {
    if (!db) return done(false);
    var tx = db.transaction("kv", "readwrite"); tx.objectStore("kv").put(v, k);
    tx.oncomplete = function () { done(true); }; tx.onerror = function () { done(false); };
  });
}
function idbGet(k, cb) {
  idb(function (db) {
    if (!db) return cb(null);
    var rq = db.transaction("kv").objectStore("kv").get(k);
    rq.onsuccess = function () { cb(rq.result || null); }; rq.onerror = function () { cb(null); };
  });
}
function bgPause() { try { bgv.pause(); } catch (e) {} }
function bgResume() {
  if (current || reduceMotion || bgv.style.display === "none" || !bgv.getAttribute("src")) return;
  var p = bgv.play(); if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function () {});
}
function showVideo(src) {
  bgAlt.style.display = "none"; bgv.style.display = "block"; retrig(bgv, "bgin");
  if (src && bgv.getAttribute("data-cur") !== src) { bgv.src = src; bgv.setAttribute("data-cur", src); }
  bgResume();
}
function showAlt(css) {
  bgPause(); bgv.style.display = "none";
  bgAlt.style.background = css; bgAlt.style.backgroundSize = "cover"; bgAlt.style.backgroundPosition = "center";
  bgAlt.style.display = "block"; retrig(bgAlt, "bgin");
}
function isVideoUrl(u) { return /\.(mp4|webm|ogv|mov)(\?|#|$)/i.test(u); }
function cssUrl(u) { return 'center / cover no-repeat url("' + String(u).replace(/"/g, "%22") + '")'; }
function applyBackground() {
  var s = bgState || { type: "video" };
  if (s.type === "preset") {
    var p = BGPRESETS.filter(function (x) { return x[0] === s.value; })[0];
    if (p) return showAlt(p[2]);
  } else if (s.type === "url" && s.value) {
    return isVideoUrl(s.value) ? showVideo(s.value) : showAlt(cssUrl(s.value));
  } else if (s.type === "file") {
    return idbGet("bgfile", function (blob) {
      if (!blob) { bgState = { type: "video" }; LS.set("bg", bgState); return applyBackground(); }
      if (bgObjUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(bgObjUrl);
      bgObjUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      if ((blob.type || "").indexOf("video") === 0) showVideo(bgObjUrl); else showAlt(cssUrl(bgObjUrl));
    });
  }
  // default: the built-in blossom video
  if (window.__bgDefault) showVideo(window.__bgDefault);
  else { bgAlt.style.display = "none"; bgv.style.display = "block"; }
}

function bgSettingsHTML() {
  var cur = bgState || { type: "video" };
  var on = function (type, val) { return cur.type === type && (val === undefined || cur.value === val) ? " on" : ""; };
  var tiles = '<button class="bgtile' + (cur.type === "video" ? " on" : "") + '" data-bg="video" style="background-image:url(' + bgv.getAttribute("poster") + ')"><span>Sakura video</span></button>' +
    BGPRESETS.map(function (p) { return '<button class="bgtile' + on("preset", p[0]) + '" data-bg="preset:' + p[0] + '" style="background:' + p[2] + '"><span>' + p[1] + '</span></button>'; }).join("");
  return '<div class="opt"><h2>Background</h2><p class="sub" style="margin-bottom:0">Pick one, or use your own image or video.</p>' +
    '<div class="bgtiles" id="bgtiles">' + tiles + '</div>' +
    '<div class="btns"><button class="btn" id="bgupload">Upload image or video…</button>' +
    '<input type="file" id="bgfile" accept="image/*,video/*" style="display:none" /></div>' +
    '<div class="row" style="margin-top:14px"><div><label>…or paste an image / video link</label>' +
    '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><input class="f" id="bgurl" placeholder="https://…" value="' + esc(cur.type === "url" ? cur.value : "") + '" />' +
    '<button class="btn ghost" id="bgurlgo">Use</button></div></div>' +
    '<div><label>Darkness over the background: <span id="dimv">' + LS.get("dim", 25) + '</span>%</label>' +
    '<input type="range" min="0" max="85" value="' + LS.get("dim", 25) + '" id="dim" /></div></div>' +
    '<div class="msg" id="bgmsg">' + (cur.type === "file" && cur.name ? "Using your file: " + esc(cur.name) : "") + '</div></div>' +
    '<div class="opt"><h2>Effects</h2><label class="chk"><input type="checkbox" id="fxchk"' + (clickFx ? " checked" : "") + ' /> Click animation (bubbles + ripple)</label>' +
    '<label class="chk" style="margin-top:10px"><input type="checkbox" id="bubchk"' + (bubOn ? " checked" : "") + ' /> Floating bubbles in the background</label></div>';
}
function bindBgSettings() {
  var msg = function (m) { var e = document.getElementById("bgmsg"); if (e) e.textContent = m; };
  var refresh = function () { var y = window.scrollY; renderSettings(); window.scrollTo(0, y); };
  document.getElementById("bgtiles").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest(".bgtile"); if (!b) return;
    var v = b.dataset.bg;
    bgState = v === "video" ? { type: "video" } : { type: "preset", value: v.split(":")[1] };
    LS.set("bg", bgState); applyBackground(); refresh();
  });
  document.getElementById("bgupload").onclick = function () { document.getElementById("bgfile").click(); };
  document.getElementById("bgfile").onchange = function () {
    var f = this.files && this.files[0]; if (!f) return;

    msg("Loading…");

      if (ok) { bgState = { type: "file", name: f.name }; LS.set("bg", bgState); applyBackground(); refresh(); }
      else { // storage unavailable: use it for this visit only
        if (bgObjUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(bgObjUrl); bgObjUrl = URL.createObjectURL(f);
        if (f.type.indexOf("video") === 0) showVideo(bgObjUrl); else showAlt(cssUrl(bgObjUrl));

  };
  document.getElementById("bgurlgo").onclick = function () {
    var u = document.getElementById("bgurl").value.trim();

    bgState = { type: "url", value: u }; LS.set("bg", bgState); applyBackground(); refresh();
  };
  document.getElementById("dim").oninput = function () {
    var n = +this.value; setDim(n); LS.set("dim", n); document.getElementById("dimv").textContent = n;
  };
  document.getElementById("fxchk").onchange = function () { clickFx = this.checked; LS.set("clickfx", clickFx); };
  document.getElementById("bubchk").onchange = function () { bubOn = this.checked; LS.set("bubbles", bubOn); document.body.classList.toggle("nobub", !bubOn); };
}

/* ---------- export / import ---------- */
function blobToDataUrl(blob, cb) { var r = new FileReader(); r.onload = function () { cb(r.result); }; r.onerror = function () { cb(null); }; r.readAsDataURL(blob); }

}
function dataSettingsHTML() {

    '<div class="btns"><button class="btn" id="expbtn">Export data (.json)</button>' +

function collectExport(includeFile, done) {

  ["favs", "plays", "bg", "dim", "cloak", "panic", "dest", "clickfx", "look", "bubbles"].forEach(function (k) {
    var v = LS.get(k, undefined); if (v !== undefined) out.data[k] = v;

    });

function cleanImport(d) {
  var c = {}, isStr = function (x) { return typeof x === "string" && x.length < 2000; }, isHttp = function (x) { return isStr(x) && /^https?:\/\//i.test(x); };
  if (Array.isArray(d.favs)) c.favs = d.favs.filter(isStr).slice(0, 5000);
  if (d.plays && typeof d.plays === "object" && !Array.isArray(d.plays)) {
    c.plays = {}; Object.keys(d.plays).slice(0, 5000).forEach(function (k) { var n = d.plays[k]; if (typeof n === "number" && isFinite(n) && n > 0) c.plays[k] = Math.floor(n); });
  }

    else if (b.type === "url" && isHttp(b.value)) c.bg = { type: "url", value: b.value };
    else if (b.type === "file") c.bg = { type: "file", name: isStr(b.name) ? b.name : "background" };
  }
  if (typeof d.dim === "number" && isFinite(d.dim)) c.dim = Math.max(0, Math.min(85, Math.round(d.dim)));
  if (typeof d.cloak === "string" && d.cloak.length < 400) c.cloak = d.cloak;
  if (typeof d.panic === "string" && d.panic.length <= 12) c.panic = d.panic;
  if (isHttp(d.dest)) c.dest = d.dest;
  if (typeof d.clickfx === "boolean") c.clickfx = d.clickfx;
  if (typeof d.bubbles === "boolean") c.bubbles = d.bubbles;
  if (d.look && typeof d.look === "object") {
    var L = d.look, o = {}, num = function (x, lo, hi) { return typeof x === "number" && isFinite(x) ? Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, x)) : undefined; };
    if (["off", "subtle", "smooth", "playful"].indexOf(L.anim) !== -1) o.anim = L.anim;
    if (["s", "m", "l"].indexOf(L.size) !== -1) o.size = L.size;
    if (typeof L.acc === "string" && /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(L.acc)) o.acc = L.acc;
    [["speed", 0.5, 2], ["radius", 0, 28], ["blur", 0, 30], ["panel", 30, 95], ["fs", 14, 20]].forEach(function (r) { var v = num(L[r[0]], r[1], r[2]); if (v !== undefined) o[r[0]] = v; });
    c.look = o;
  }
  return c;
}
function applyImport(obj, say) {
  if (!obj || obj.app !== "aero" && obj.app !== "sakura" || typeof obj.data !== "object" || !obj.data) return say("That doesn't look like an Aero backup file.");
  var c = cleanImport(obj.data), n = 0;
  var finish = function () {
    if (c.favs) { var set = {}; favs.concat(c.favs).forEach(function (u) { set[u] = 1; }); favs = Object.keys(set); LS.set("favs", favs); n++; }
    if (c.plays) { Object.keys(c.plays).forEach(function (u) { plays[u] = Math.max(playsOf(u), c.plays[u]); }); LS.set("plays", plays); n++; }
    if (c.bg) { bgState = c.bg; LS.set("bg", bgState); n++; }
    if (c.dim !== undefined) { LS.set("dim", c.dim); setDim(c.dim); n++; }
    ["cloak", "panic", "dest"].forEach(function (k) { if (c[k] !== undefined) { LS.set(k, c[k]); n++; } });
    if (c.clickfx !== undefined) { clickFx = c.clickfx; LS.set("clickfx", clickFx); n++; }
    if (c.bubbles !== undefined) { bubOn = c.bubbles; LS.set("bubbles", bubOn); document.body.classList.toggle("nobub", !bubOn); n++; }
    if (c.look) { look = Object.assign({}, LOOK_DEF, c.look); saveLook(); applyLook(); n++; }
    applyBackground(); applyCloak(); renderSettings();
    var m = document.getElementById("datamsg"); if (m) m.textContent = "Imported. Favorites and play counts were merged with what you already had."; toast("Backup imported");
  };
  var bf = obj.backgroundFile;
  if (c.bg && c.bg.type === "file") {
    var blob = bf && typeof bf.dataUrl === "string" && /^data:(image|video)\//.test(bf.dataUrl) ? dataUrlToBlob(bf.dataUrl) : null;
    if (blob) return idbSet("bgfile", blob, function (ok) { if (!ok) c.bg = { type: "video" }; finish(); });
    c.bg = { type: "video" }; // no file inside the backup
  }
  finish();
}
function bindDataSettings() {
  var say = function (m) { var e = document.getElementById("datamsg"); if (e) e.textContent = m; };
  document.getElementById("expbtn").onclick = function () {
    var inc = document.getElementById("expfile"); say("Preparing…");
    collectExport(inc ? inc.checked : false, function (obj) {
      var blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
      var a = document.createElement("a"), d = new Date(), p = function (n) { return (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n; };
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = "aero-backup-" + d.getFullYear() + "-" + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + p(d.getDate()) + ".json";
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); }, 4000);
      say("Backup saved as " + a.download + "."); toast("Backup saved");
    });
  };
  document.getElementById("impbtn").onclick = function () { document.getElementById("impfile").click(); };
  document.getElementById("impfile").onchange = function () {
    var f = this.files && this.files[0]; if (!f) return;
    if (f.size > 400 * 1024 * 1024) return say("That file is too big to be an Aero backup.");
    var r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = function () { var o; try { o = JSON.parse(r.result); } catch (e) { return say("That file isn't valid JSON."); } applyImport(o, say); };
    r.onerror = function () { say("Couldn't read that file."); };
    r.readAsText(f);
  };
}

/* ---------- click animation ---------- */
var clickFx = LS.get("clickfx", true);
var bubOn = LS.get("bubbles", true);
(function () {
  var host = document.getElementById("bubbles"), n = 16;
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    var b = document.createElement("span"), s = 18 + Math.random() * 64;
    b.className = "bub"; b.style.width = b.style.height = s + "px"; b.style.left = (Math.random() * 100) + "%";
    b.style.setProperty("--d", (16 + Math.random() * 20) + "s"); b.style.setProperty("--dl", (-Math.random() * 30) + "s");
    b.style.setProperty("--sx", (Math.random() * 80 - 40) + "px"); host.appendChild(b);
  }
  document.body.classList.toggle("nobub", !bubOn);
})();
var fxLayer = document.getElementById("fx");
function spawnFx(x, y) {
  var r = document.createElement("span"); r.className = "rip"; r.style.left = x + "px"; r.style.top = y + "px"; fxLayer.appendChild(r);
  setTimeout(function () { r.remove(); }, 700);
  for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    var p = document.createElement("span"); p.className = "petal";
    var ang = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 8 + Math.random() * 0.6, d = 38 + Math.random() * 46, sz = 7 + Math.random() * 12; p.style.width = p.style.height = sz + "px";
    p.style.left = x + "px"; p.style.top = y + "px";
    p.style.setProperty("--dx", Math.cos(ang) * d + "px"); p.style.setProperty("--dy", Math.sin(ang) * d - 26 + "px");
    p.style.setProperty("--rot", Math.round(Math.random() * 360 - 180) + "deg");
    fxLayer.appendChild(p); (function (n) { setTimeout(function () { n.remove(); }, 900); })(p);
  }
}
document.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (e) { if (clickFx && !animOff() && !reduceMotion && e.button === 0) spawnFx(e.clientX, e.clientY); }, true);

applyBackground();

applyCloak();
render();
pageEnter();
</script>
<script>window.__BG__ = "";</script>
<script>
(function () {
  try {
    var bin = atob(window.__BG__), n = bin.length, bytes = new Uint8Array(n);
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
    window.__BG__ = null;
    window.__bgDefault = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: "video/mp4" }));
  } catch (e) {}
  if (window.applyBackground) window.applyBackground();
  // some browsers block autoplay until the first click/tap
  ["pointerdown", "keydown", "touchstart"].forEach(function (ev) {
    document.addEventListener(ev, function () { if (window.bgResume) window.bgResume(); }, { once: true, passive: true });
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
